notes:
### Added
- Material library. Save: toolbar "Save Material from Model" (eyedropper) or
  "Pick material" in the library window, then click a surface: the material
  you see (face, back face, or the group/component colour) opens in the save
  form with a swatch, name and tags pre-filled. Stored as .skm (texture,
  colour, scale, opacity) with a thumbnail in `<library>/_materials`.
- Library window has Models | Materials tabs. Clicking a material swatch
  selects it and starts SketchUp's Paint Bucket, so it is poured onto faces
  (Ctrl/Shift modifiers work as usual). A material is loaded into a model
  once and reused afterwards.
- Materials support the same management as models: drag to a category,
  double-click rename, edit, remove to `_trash`, rename category.
